description: Lists segments on the current site, paginated (response includes `has_more`). Each item carries segment_id, name, current subscriber count, status, and any URL matching criteria.

limit.description: How many segments to return in this page. Min 1, max 100, default 10. To browse past the first 100, increase `page` instead of asking for a larger limit.

name_contains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on segment_name.

page.description: Page number (1-indexed) for paginating beyond the first batch. e.g. with limit=100 the second page (segments 101–200) is page=2.

name: pushengage_list_segments
title: List segments
